'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan]]
*****The [[Jordanian Armed Forces|Jordanian military]] reports that [[air defense]]s have intercepted 8 out of 10 projectiles fired by [[Iran]] against [[Jordan|the country]] in [[Aqaba]] near the [[Borders of Israel#Border with Jordan|Israeli border]], with two missiles landing in remote areas. [https://abcnews.com/International/live-updates/iran-live-updates-kuwait-attacked-bahrain-sounds-sirens/?id=134907987&entryId=134976265&cid=social_twitter_abcn (ABC News)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/us-iran-jordan-attack-9.7279102 (CBC)] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/hyfx6gcnmx (Ynetnews)]
****[[Kuwait in the 2026 Iran war]]
*****The [[Chief of the General Staff (Kuwait)|General Staff]] of the [[Kuwait Land Forces|Kuwait Army]] reports that [[Kuwait]]'s [[Kuwaiti Armed Forces|military]] and air defenses have been actively intercepting "hostile [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drones]]" from Iran. [https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwait-is-currently-intercepting-hostile-missiles-and-drone-attacks/ (''Arab Times Kuwait'')] [https://timeskuwait.com/kuwaiti-armed-forces-intercept-hostile-drones/ (''The Times Kuwait'')]
***[[July 2026 United States strikes against Iran]]
****The [[United States Armed Forces|United States military]] launches [[Tomahawk missile]] strikes on Iran's [[Larak Island]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2026/07/22/iran-media-report-us-strike-on-island-of-larak-in-hormuz (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
****The [[United States Central Command|U.S. Central Command]] launches a new round of strikes against Iran, marking the 12th consecutive day of attacks. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-hormuz-strait-war-july-22-2026-42ff3de8d135ad72ff3ba4d94cc0921d (AP)] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/us-military-launches-new-round-strikes-iran?topic=War%2520on%2520Iran&nid=442386&fid=556969 (''Middle East Eye'')]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****''[[Financial Times]]'' reports that the [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] ''Kavomalaes'', belonging to [[Greece|Greek]] shipowner [[George Prokopiou]], was "highly likely" to have been [[List of ships attacked during the 2026 Iran war|captured]] in the [[Strait of Hormuz]] by Iran two days earlier. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2026/07/22/iran-apparently-seizes-greek-billionaires-shipping-tanker-in-strait-of-hormuz-report-says/ (''Forbes'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] and [[Shin Bet]] announces that they have killed three [[Hamas]] militants in the northern [[Gaza Strip]], including one in the Hamas military wing that took part in the [[October 7 attacks]] on [[Israel]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-903436 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.clevelandjewishnews.com/news/world_news/idf-slays-hamas-terrorist-who-invaded-israel-on-oct-7/article_dec2ad1b-237b-5b70-81e4-2ac406074054.html (''Cleveland Jewish News'')]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***Seven [[oil]] tankers departing [[Saudi Arabia]]'s [[Yanbu Commercial Port|port]] of [[Yanbu]] change course away from the [[Bab-el-Mandeb|Strait of Bab-el-Mandeb]] after the [[Houthi-controlled Yemen|Houthis]] announced a blockade on Saudi Arabian ports. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/07/21/ships-bound-saudi-arabia-turn-around-sign-new-red-sea-blockade/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/more-ships-change-course-red-sea-after-houthi-threats-shipping-data-shows-2026-07-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***[[UNICEF]] reports that six people, including two children, have been killed and 30 people including children have been injured in a drone strike on a market in [[Er Rahad|Al-Rahad]], [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/drone-strike-on-sudan-market-kills-injures-over-30-including-children-unicef/4006227 (AA)]
**A [[Chadians|Chadian]] official reports that a drone attack from [[Sudan]]ese territory has attacked positions in [[Chad]], injuring civilians and destroying vehicles and several shops. The attack is the fifth in recent months, following an incursion by [[Rapid Support Forces]] last January. [https://sudantribune.com/article/316499 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Sixteen civilians, most of whom gold miners, are killed during a village attack suspected to have been perpetrated by [[Allied Democratic Forces|ADF]] forces in Mandeite locality, [[Mambasa]], [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/16-civilians-killed-in-new-rebel-attack-in-eastern-congo/4006927 (AA)]
*[[Southern Thailand insurgency]]
**Five [[Royal Thai Armed Forces|soldiers]] are killed and six civilians are injured in a [[mass shooting]] by ten unknown gunmen at a [[security checkpoint]] in [[Narathiwat province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/23/five-soldiers-killed-in-southern-thailand-checkpoint-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**A 35-year-old [[head constable]] is shot and killed in a militant attack in [[Anantnag]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [[The Resistance Front]] claims responsibility. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/j-k-terror-attack-cctv-shows-terrorist-shooting-jammu-and-kashmir-cop-at-point-blank-range-11805916 (NDTV)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***[[Price of oil|Oil prices]], including [[Brent Crude]] and [[West Texas Intermediate]], rise to over [[United States dollar|US$]]95 and $86 per [[Barrel (unit)|barrel]], respectively, and the [[United States]] average [[gasoline]] price rises to $4.06 per [[gallon]], amidst the ongoing conflict. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven people are killed after a truck collides with a medical transport van in [[Pernambuco]], [[Brazil]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260723/034861ad666249f08105835e50c6a41e/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]], [[Nuclear program of Saudi Arabia]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] and the [[United States]] sign a civil nuclear cooperation agreement allowing Saudi Arabia to use [[Nuclear power in the United States|U.S.]] [[Nuclear reactor|reactor]] technology, [[Enriched uranium|enrich uranium]], and [[Nuclear reprocessing|reprocess]] [[nuclear waste]]. The pact excludes the [[IAEA]] [[Nuclear proliferation#Additional Protocol|Additional Protocol]] and proceeds to [[United States Congress|U.S. congressional]] review. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260722-us-announces-civilian-nuclear-deal-with-saudi-arabia-1 (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/us-says-it-reached-nuclear-cooperation-deal-with-saudi-arabia-2026-07-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Stabbing of Salman Rushdie]]
**The [[Federal tribunals in the United States|federal trial]] against [[Hadi Matar]], the man who attempted to kill author [[Salman Rushdie]] in August 2022 in [[New York (state)|New York]], United States, opens. If he is convicted, Matar faces a sentence of [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life in prison]]. He is already serving a 25-year state prison sentence in New York. [https://apnews.com/article/salman-rushdie-stabbing-trial-hadi-matar-5d2a06a832e8a3848cff7e8b58b7a17e (AP)] [https://www.theguardian.com/books/2026/jul/22/salman-rushdie-attacker-faces-us-terrorism-trial (''The Guardian'')]
*Unknown gunmen open fire at a police station in [[Canindeyú Department]], [[Paraguay]], killing three officers and wounding another. [https://www.abc.com.py/policiales/2026/07/22/policia-dice-tener-algunos-nombres-de-los-atacantes-de-la-comisaria-de-naranjito/ (Abc.com)]
